result_summary.title: UI rendering issues and missing features after release
result_summary.description: After the latest release to our EU-West staging environment, we are seeing UI elements not rendering correctly in the Self-Service Hub, and some features appear to be missing entirely. This has a high business impact and affects 524 users. Please investigate the changes made in the recent release.
